stem:
Wafa has line $n$ and wants a line through point $Q$ parallel to $n$ by copying a corresponding angle from a transversal.

Which plan works?

options.text: Copy an angle at $Q$ with no transversal that cuts line $n$, and claim the new line is parallel to $n$.
The transversal through $n$ comes from first drawing the finished parallel through $Q$.
Draw a transversal through $Q$ that cuts $n$, copy the corresponding angle at $Q$, and draw the new line through $Q$.
Slide a set-square along $n$ and treat that tool method as this corresponding-angle copy.

teacher.key_rationale: A transversal must cut n; copy the corresponding angle at Q; draw the new line. A omits the transversal. B reverses construction order. D swaps in a set-square slide.
